newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across the board on Tuesday, brokers said.
They said prices were lower in moderate trade on some late selling interest in line with weaker Japanese prices.
Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked down slightly today, led by steep falls in nearby months after the spot June contracts expired at sharply lower levels.

"The market was very quiet in the morning and everyone was sitting on the sidelines. But the market turned lower in the afternoon in sympathy with softer prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.

"The morning session was featureless but some selling was noted in the afternoon session as some traders were closing positions while others thought that the market was in a downtrend," another local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, September RSS3 fell two cents to 107.00 U.S. cents a kg.
July RSS1 fell 1.25 cents to 148.75 Singapore cents (US$1.05) a kg.
August TSR20 fell 1.75 cents to 141.50 Singapore cents (US$1.00) a kg.
